reason: The report uses a raw regression of 2023 patents on remote_share with no controls, even though the data hold pre-period confounders (2020 size, age, baseline patenting) that strongly predict remote_share. When I add the 2020 covariates, the coefficient falls from about 1.6 (untrimmed, no controls) to -0.28 (SE 0.24), which is not significant. So the positive-effect conclusion comes from confounding and is not supported.
